title: G12: Pitch/error-adaptive brake integral gain in the Bosch extra-brake PI

title: G1: Lag-aligned gas_error — 0.5 s deque + quasi-steady gating for the existing learner

Folds: timestamp-interpolated deque (torqued.py:175-188 pattern); anti-windup shadows (:523-532) must operate on the lagged command or saturation bias silently returns; reset deque on engagement edges/gasPressed; learn_speed can then drop toward 20-30. title: G9: Squat-isolated + delay-advanced pitch FF; brake side gets grade comp for the first time
description: Mechanism (three folded kept ideas per master map): (a) Squat isolation — hill_brake = sin(pitch)*g reads raw CC.orientationNED[1] (carcontroller.py:393-395), conflating road grade with brake dive: braking -> dive -> reads more downhill -> more brake (positive feedback, worst at end-of-stop) AND poisons the pitch feature every learner/NNGB trains on. Fix: kinematics-isolated grade from liveLocationKalman/livePose, or grok's lighter variant first (0.3 Hz low-pass + small 3-feature learned correction) — hours-days, one file. (b) Brake-side grade comp (gas-brake report G10, judge 6): hill_brake feeds gas_pedal_force only (:503); ACCEL_COMMAND has zero grade pre-compensation, so brake_pid winds up against gravity downhill. When accel < 0, pre-compensate by learned k_grade*sin(pitch)*g (k_grade starts 0, /data sidecar, G4 rails; converges ~0 if the PCM already compensates — self-neutralizing epistemics); stays out of the stopping state. (c) Delay-advanced pitch (gas-brake report L5, judge 5 — 'strictly the second half of G9, not a standalone'): pitch_pred = pitch + pitch_rate*actuator_delay (G8 value when live, else 0.5), clamped +/-0.05 rad, |pitch| < 0.2 rad sanity, deadband at the gas_pedal_force=0 BRAKE_REQUEST sign boundary — MUST land after squat isolation or it AMPLIFIES the dive feedback loop. Judge score 7 (head of the pitch cluster). Tier: next (Wave 1). Effort: hours-days lightweight, more for full Kalman routing. Recompile: none. Sequencing: prerequisite-grade for G6's pitch feature and before NNGB data collection; G6 must train on post-hill-compensation residuals (conflict table). Files: opendbc_repo/opendbc/car/honda/carcontroller.py (:393-395), sunnypilot/selfdrive/controls/lib/longitudinal_planner.py (grade routing, full variant), selfdrive/controls/lib/longcontrol.py (preview).

Bake as per-car constants. Gates folded: Huber clip 0.5deg, dRel>15 m small-angle conditioning, yaw-rate curve exclusion, N>1000 samples. Frame-convention discipline: calibrate against the exact frame radard compares in (RADAR_TO_CAMERA 1.52 m, model lateral bias) — association consistency beats absolute geometric truth; circularity to vision is a feature. Judge scores 7 (dbc offline pin) / 7.5 (radar canonical: logging-only-first -> pin-a-constant is exactly right for a single-car fleet; one good drive pins the constant). Tier: next. Effort: days, zero runtime risk. Recompile: none. Foundation of Bundle E — yRel bias leaks into prob_y association (radard.py:127) and the |yRel|<1.0 low-speed override gate (radard.py:107); a 0.5 m bias mis-selects adjacent-lane leads and no downstream MPC tuning can repair it. title: K3: Stationary-track classifier + hardened low-speed leadOne override
description: Mechanism: potential_low_speed_lead (radard.py:104-107) promotes ANY |yRel|<1.0, 0.75<dRel<25 track below v_ego 4 m/s with zero vision confirmation and zero age requirement — the felt phantom-brake generator. Add a stationary classifier to Track (radard.py:55): flag when |vLead| < 0.5 m/s sustained >=4 cycles while v_ego > V_EGO_STATIONARY, with hysteresis (clear requires |vLead| > 1.5 sustained) so the flag survives the v_ego<4 regime (a car rolling to a stop stays was-moving; a sign approached at speed stays stationary). Harden the override: (a) track age cnt >= 5; (b) measured == True (no placeholder hijacks — only meaningful because the interface flag is honest, :399-403); (c) PREFER was-moving tracks (preference not hard requirement — incarnation bumps erase the credit, and a genuinely stopped lead reborn mid-queue must remain stoppable-for). Feed the flag into match_vision_to_track sanity. Folded council gates: |vRel+v_ego| > 1.0 OR vision prob > 0.3 kinematic branch; dRel<10 m scoping. Judge score 6.5. NON-NEGOTIABLE SHIP GATE (verbatim class): with CMBS/AEB knocked out, the low-speed override is the last radar backstop for a vision-missed stopped object — counting and classifying real override activations is a SHIP GATE, not a nice-to-have, and the net-safety acceptance is an explicit OPERATOR decision, not an engineering default. title: R4: Populate yvRel (lateral rate) + shadow cut-in candidate detector
description: Mechanism: derive yvRel per slot exactly like vRel — d(yRel)/dt with the same parser clock, dt guards, EMA, break logic (extend _hist to (dRel, yRel, nanos)); yvRel hardcoded NaN today at radar_interface.py:378, schema field exists, no capnp change (settled NaN-field assignment: aRel -> KF accel, yvRel -> lateral rate, quality stays interface-internal — the one genuine schema pressure point). Then a brand-generic detector in radard: adjacent-lane band (0.5 < |yRel| < 2.5 m), yvRel signed TOWARD ego path sustained N>=4 cycles, closing/matching speed, ahead of leadOne. v1 ships LOG-ONLY (shadow mode) for a corpus drive before any planner consumption; shadow logging can ride along with Bundle F drives now. Folded: dRel<60 m restriction (lateral LSB growth), vision-corroboration prob>0.2, never-displaces invariant (the rule only ADDS a closer candidate). Judge score 6 — canonical because it ships shadow-first and gates production on boresight cal: the signal is a derivative of a trig projection of a MEDIUM-confidence azimuth with unpinned boresight — magnitude untrustworthy, sustained-sign-trend keying is the right design. description: Mechanism: STRENGTH (B0) is decoded but used only as the ==0xFE idle sentinel (radar_interface.py:297; dbc:111 confirms range co-variance; encoding unpinned — could be a coded status byte). The offline baseline fit is a hard prerequisite; the motorcycle-latency regression check is safety-relevant given the AEB knockout. Judge scores 6.5 (radar) / 5.5 (dbc). Tier: next. Effort: days. description: (long-controller kept idea #14; no master-map letter id — assigned M10 here.)
